translations.web: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
translations.bsb: And the Father who sent Me has Himself testified about Me. You have never heard His voice nor seen His form,
translations.kjv: And the Father himself, which hath sent me, hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.
translations.asv: And the Father that sent me, he hath borne witness of me. Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.
